name: Battleboar Flank
summary: In Mulgore, young hunters gather Battleboar Flanks from beasts threatening tauren hunting grounds. The meat feeds the tribe's youth.

sections.title: Sustenance from the Bristleback Threat
sections.body: Bristleback quilboar train battleboars in Brambleblade Ravine to enter tauren hunting grounds. Their attacks threaten the young tauren at Camp Narache. Grull Hawkwind sends novice hunters to take the flanks and snouts from the beasts they kill. The flank meat is cooked into stew for the tribe's youth, feeding them with what the quilboar sent against their people.

faq.q: What is a Battleboar Flank used for?
faq.answer: Young hunters at Camp Narache gather Battleboar Flanks at Grull Hawkwind's direction. The meat is cooked into stew for the village's young tauren.
Hunters carve Battleboar Flanks from Battleboars and Bristleback Battleboars near Brambleblade Ravine, east of Camp Narache in Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Why are the battleboars encroaching on tauren land?
faq.answer: Bristleback quilboar breed and train the battleboars to be hostile. As tensions rise between the Bristlebacks and tauren, the quilboar drive the beasts into traditional tauren hunting grounds to harass the newcomers.

angles.text: As a tauren, hunting battleboars threatening your homeland teaches you to defend it while respecting and using the Earth Mother's bounty.
As a cook, you can boil the flank slowly into a filling communal camp stew.
